checks.falsifier: any class_id != AF-SCC-C0-VAC-GEN, or any unknown AF-* token outside the frozen four, falsifies this check

checks.name: ordered quantifier prefix forall-exists(comeager)-forall-not_exists
checks.falsifier: a reordering or a dropped comeager quantifier in the frozen prefix falsifies this check

checks.name: vacuum, Lambda=0, 4d, one AF end, both constraints, regularity named

detail.regularity_default: smooth-with-decay: h and K of class C^infinity with the numeric rates below

checks.falsifier: a non-vacuum matter entry, Lambda != 0, dimension != 4 or a missing constraint falsifies this check

checks.name: genericity kind is a canonical alias-registry token, topology named
checks.falsifier: changing genericity.kind to a token absent from VOCAB_ALIASES.json, or dropping the topology, falsifies this check

checks.name: SCC-C0 conclusion token, no WCC content in the asserted statement
checks.falsifier: a WCC predicate (visibility / I+ completeness) inside conclusion.*, or a conclusion_type outside the alias registry, falsifies this check

checks.name: C0 => C2 recorded and the converse forbidden

detail.cross_family_rule: no WCC <-> SCC transfer is licensed by this artifact

checks.falsifier: a transfer row from C2 (or H2_loc) to C0, or a removed C0=>C2 row, falsifies this check

checks.name: tier-1 refutes exactly this class; tier-2 labelled strengthening-only
checks.falsifier: a tier-1 falsifier that refutes a different class, or an unlabelled tier-2 strengthening refutation, falsifies this check

checks.falsifier: an H2_loc/C2 regularity or a distributional-Ricci equation requirement in extension_predicate falsifies this check

checks.falsifier: any theorem_id absent from ledger/theorems.jsonl, or any status disagreement, falsifies this check

checks.name: declared revised_at is not in the future relative to mtime/wall clock

checks.falsifier: a class-separation finding on these exact bytes falsifies this check

checks.name: canonical structural checker accepts this schema (corroboration only)
checks.falsifier: canonical checker exit != 0 or verdict != pass on these bytes falsifies this corroboration

findings.title: duplicate top-level YAML keys in the canonical schema
findings.impact: yaml.safe_load resolves duplicates last-wins, so the effective revised_at is the last entry; strict YAML parsers reject the document. Revision history is encoded as repeated keys, not as a sequence.
findings.falsifier: a strict duplicate-key parser run on the same bytes that exits 0, or a revision of the file with unique keys

findings.title: declared revised_at is ahead of wall-clock and of the file mtime
findings.impact: the header's own timestamp_provenance records a prior ahead-of-clock correction; this recurrence makes the declared revision time unusable as evidence and interacts with the project-wide clock-discipline finding (future_dated events).
findings.falsifier: a restored/rewritten file whose declared revised_at is <= its mtime and <= wall clock

findings.title: canonical F0 vocabulary lists alias tokens rather than canonical alias-registry tokens
findings.impact: F2b itself uses the canonical tokens; the inversion is in the declared F0 binding artifact, so it is recorded here as a cross-artifact note for F0, not as an F2b failure.
findings.falsifier: a canonical F0 revision whose field_vocabulary.allowed lists the alias-registry canonical tokens first

binding_rule: this verdict binds only to sha256_before; if the file hash changed before a gate verdict is recorded, the verdict is advisory and must be re-run
falsifier: Re-run this script against the same sha256. The review is falsified if (a) any check recorded pass fails on identical bytes; (b) the class-separation scan or the canonical checker disagrees with the recorded verdicts; (c) the F2b file's declared f0_binding hash no longer equals the measured canonical F0 hash; (d) any ledger ref status changes; or (e) a strict duplicate-key parse of the same bytes exits 0 while F01 is recorded. A revision after sha256_before is drift, not a falsifier of the snapshot.
